title: Find Your Friends
plot_overview: A carefree getaway with friends takes a dangerous turn when tensions with hostile locals escalate. As old trauma resurfaces and toxic group dynamics pull the friends apart, their party trip becomes a violent fight for survival and revenge.
will_you_like_this: You may enjoy this if you like dark, tension-driven thrillers such as Jolt or The Quarry; Not for you if you prefer lighthearted travel stories or easygoing friendships.
review_summary: Pros: tense premise; dark atmosphere; escalating danger | Cons: toxic dynamics; grim subject matter; limited context
